note: D274 · the visual-system lint lands with a baseline, or it lands nothing. Each entry is the number of pre-system sites a check found on the day it was written; the check FAILS when the count rises and reports the new floor when it falls. Lower the number in the same commit that lowers the count. A baseline of 0 is zero-tolerance from then on, and the entry stays so the intent is on the record. lowered 2026-09-07 · D291 (the case, the record, recent rounds) — three fell when the record stopped being four bordered `bg1` tiles and the You tab's record and recent list left their `.card` wrappers: `.rec`'s 10px radius and its bg1+border ground went with `.recgrid` and `.recmoney` (LINT-05 held, LINT-10 −1), and eight hand-typed spaces and two off-scale trackings became the space and role classes (LINT-06 −2, LINT-07 −2), one hand-typed font stack left with `.rec` (LINT-03 −1), and the ⛳ empty state and the photo-tab button on the recent list took two emoji with them (LINT-12 −2). No baseline rose. lowered 2026-09-08 · D309/D310/D311 (the reaction tokens) — five fell when the six emoji became four drawn tokens and the tray came out of both clients: LINT-12 −7 (the six reaction glyphs in BoardModels, the two demo rows and the palette's own six on the desk), and the desk's `.rxpalette` block, the `.rxchip.quick` rule and the tray's hand-typed spacing left the stylesheet with it (LINT-05 −1, LINT-10 −3, LINT-06 −9, LINT-03 −2). No baseline rose. **The reactions were LINT-12's own stated exemption** — *'the six canon reactions and a golfer's own typed text'* — so this is the one drop that shrinks what the check has to forgive rather than what the product does.
